target.title: docs: define islo gateway profile and document live smoke env vars
target.body:
## Summary

- Define the previously unexplained `gatewayProfile` key/flag/env on both islo pages: Crabbox passes the value opaquely in the Islo sandbox-create request, it accepts a profile name or id, profiles are created and managed on the Islo side, and it configures Islo's own egress gateway for the sandbox — unrelated to the Crabbox coordinator (`docs/providers/islo.md`, `docs/features/islo.md`).
- Add a **Live testing** section to `docs/providers/islo.md` for the two opt-in `-tags smoke` tests in `internal/providers/islo/backend_live_test.go`: the read-only `TestLiveIsloStatusClassification` (needs `ISLO_API_KEY`, skips otherwise) and the mutating `TestLiveIsloPauseResumeLifecycle` (additionally gated on `CRABBOX_LIVE_ISLO_PAUSE_RESUME=1`), the `ISLO_BASE_URL` / `CRABBOX_LIVE_ISLO_IMAGE` overrides, cleanup guidance, and the gotcha that the live tests read `ISLO_API_KEY` only — `CRABBOX_ISLO_API_KEY` is not consulted.
- Document `status --wait` behavior: 2-second poll, 5-minute default `--wait-timeout`, and terminal-state fail-fast (`failed`/`stopped`/`stopping`/`deleted`) exiting 5; and that `crabbox ssh` auto-resumes a paused sandbox with an up-to-2-minute wait.
- Document the URL-bridge share TTL clamp into Islo's legal 60s–7d range and the 30-second expiry skew for share reuse, matching the phrasing already used in `docs/commands/pond.md`.
- Fix the transport-split sentence on both pages to include pause/resume among SDK-driven operations.

## Notes

- The live-smoke docs follow the contract in `docs/features/provider-live-smoke.md` ("Provider Docs": each provider documents its own opt-in smoke), so the new section lives in `docs/providers/islo.md` — matching the existing `docs/providers/morph.md` and `docs/providers/wandb.md` precedent — with a cross-link to the feature page added under Related docs. `provider-live-smoke.md` itself is unchanged.
- Docs-only change; no smoke shell script added.
- Relates to https://github.com/openclaw/crabbox/issues/944

## Verification

- `bash scripts/check-docs.sh`
